# US EV Charging Industry Primer

## Executive Summary
The EV charging industry combines equipment, site deployment, utilities, site hosts, network operators, and demand tied to EV adoption. [claim_1] [claim_2] [claim_3] [claim_4]

## Industry Definition
EV charging infrastructure includes hardware, site preparation, utility connection, and network services. [claim_1]

## Value Chain
The value chain includes equipment suppliers, installers, utilities, site hosts, and charging-network operators. [claim_2]

## Key Players
Charging-network operators are one key participant group; the fixture does not rank individual companies. [claim_4]

## Demand Drivers
Public charging demand is linked to electric vehicle adoption. [claim_3]

## Risks
Utility interconnection can affect deployment timelines. [claim_5]

## Open Questions
- Which local utility territories and site-host types matter most for the target use case?
- How do installation timelines vary by state or metro area? [claim_5]
